SolvedProblem.title: SolvedProblem
SolvedProblem.description: A solved mathematics problem and its solution saved in a user's personal history.

question.description: The original math problem or expression entered by the user.

answer.description: The formatted solution steps and explanation returned by the solver or AI.

finalResult.description: Short summary of the final result.

source.description: Whether solved by the local engine or AI.

isFavorite.description: Whether the user bookmarked this solved problem.

notes.description: Optional personal study note attached by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the problem was first saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest modification.

SavedChat.title: SavedChat
SavedChat.description: A saved chat session belonging to a user.

title.description: Display title of the saved chat.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat was saved.

/users/{userId}/solvedProblems/{problemI.description: Per-user collection of solved math problems and solutions for later review.

/userChats/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Per-user collection of saved chat sessions.
